exec: const n = (Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('loginBurst')) || 0) + 1;

pm.test('RateLimit headers tell the client where it stands', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('RateLimit') || pm.response.headers.has('RateLimit-Limit')).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('error names the limit that was hit', function () { const e = pm.response.json().errors[0]; pm.expect(e.field).to.eql('rateLimit'); pm.expect(e.message).to.match(/limit of \d+ requests? per/); });
pm.test('message says what was limited', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('login attempts'); });
pm.test('response leaks no internals or password hash', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/node_modules|MongoServerError|passwordHash|\s+at\s.+:\d+:\d+/); });
